hero.subtitle: Plug Patreon login into your app with one shared Code Exchange flow for web and mobile.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Patreon uses the OAuth2 Authorization Code flow. After consent, the API fetches the user identity from Patreon API v2, creates a short-lived single-use exchange code in Redis, and your client exchanges it for the same JWTs you get from password login. Scopes identity and identity[email] are required for email.

console.title: Patreon Developer Portal
console.description: Register a client in the Patreon Developer Portal → set Redirect URI to PATREON_CALLBACK_URL and request scopes identity and identity[email].

api.title: API contract
api.description: The API exposes a start URL and a callback that issues the exchange code.

codeHeader.label: Start
codeHeader.context: Redirect the user to Patreon consent

codeHeader.label: Callback
codeHeader.context: Patreon redirects back to the API

userModel.title: User model
userModel.description: The Patreon user resource id from identity is stored as patreonId. Email comes from the identity attributes when identity[email] scope is granted.
